title: Bamboo Lending
tagline: Collateralized physical p2p borrow and lending marketplace using web 3 social
description:
A borrow/lending marketplace where users can borrow physical items for the time they need them, instead of buying the item, while the lender generates revenue from non-used stored items with collaterized value.

Circular economy using web 3 social bringing together re-use, social reputation, smart contract systems for p2p lending.
how_its_made:
TLDR: Collateralized physical p2p borrow and lending marketplace using web 3 social.

Which Technologies:
Built and deployed on the Polygon zkEVM, Gnosis and Scroll chains, integrating Wallet Connect, Lens Protocol and World coin id validators.

Items posted on Lens, to see what the user has post before and the interactions with the ecosystem.

How are they pieced together:

How did this technologies benefit the product?
Through the use of Polygon zkEVM, Gnosis and Scroll we get faster and cheap L2 transactions than on L1.
We use  wallet connect for easier onboarding and ramp of money from the end user perspective bringin FIAT into crypto assets.
Social verifications of lens and Worldcoin Id allow us to improve the verification system and further exposure of real users for lending items.
Lens allows us also to post the stuff into the dApps for the followers to get them, using social groups for improved searching.

Notable Stuff:
We are looking to add value for non web3 users to bring the next billion wallets to the ecosystem.
